violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ONSITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM MUST BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF FOOD OPERATION. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION TO PREVENT ENFORCEMENT ACTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item was observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED TURKEY MEATBALLS AT 119F AND RICE AT 119-126F IN THE CAMBRO.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PROPER HOT HOLDING PROCEDURES WERE REVIEWED WITH THE PIC. PLEASE ENSURE HOT HOLDING FOODS ARE ALWAYS KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE. ALL FOOD WAS SERVED WITHIN TWO HOURS OF RECEIVING. PIC DOCUMENTED RECEIVING TEMPERATURES AND UNDERSTANDS RECEIVING TEMPERATURES SHOULD ALWAYS BE DOCUMENTED WHEN RECEIVING TCS FOODS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CHEESE STICKS AT 47-62F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF CHEESE STICKS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD ALWAYS BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE 1-DOOR MIDEA COOLER AT 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED OF CHEESE STICKS THAT WERE NOT COLD HOLDING PROPERLY DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING UNITS SHOULD BE KEPT BETWEN 34-38F. SINCE THIS COOLER IS NOT NSF APPROVED OR EQUIVALENT AND NOT COLD HOLDING PROPERLY, THE PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT A NEW NSF APPROVED OR EQUIVALENT COOLER SHOULD BE INSTALLED. PLEASE PROVIDE THE SPECIFICATIONS FOR A NEW COOLER TO THE EHS BY THE TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION AND PRIOR TO PURCHASING FOR APPROVAL.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold holding equipment: 1-DOOR UPR RIGHT WITHOUT A UNIT THERMOMETER.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PLEASE ADD UNIT THERMOMETER AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
